title: Parameter-Efficient Prompt Tuning Research (EMNLP 2021)
summary: This community centers on the seminal paper "The Power of Scale for Parameter-Efficient Prompt Tuning," published at the 2021 Conference on Empirical Methods in Natural Language Processing (EMNLP). The work is authored by Brian Lester, Rami Al-Rfou, and Noah Constant, who investigate the efficacy of prompt tuning methods in large-scale language models. The cluster highlights the specific contribution of this research to the field of parameter-efficient fine-tuning strategies.
key_findings: The paper "The Power of Scale for Parameter-Efficient Prompt Tuning" was published in the proceedings of EMNLP 2021.
